en: Black‑and‑white rural landscape showing a small mountain stream with rocks in the foreground, flowing through a valley of rolling hills. On the left hillside stands a large chalet‑style house with balconies and a steep tiled roof with a small turret, while another similar villa is visible further up the slope. On the right are fenced meadows and a tall wooden barn. A simple footbridge crosses the stream in the middle distance. In the lower right, three children in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing sit and stand on the stone embankment along the water. The scene is tranquil and alpine, with forested slopes in the background. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.
